race.comment: TREASURED LEGACY (10) is a maiden galloper resuming from a spell but started odds-on on debut in a much tougher race than this when she got it all wrong. Has trialled well since, draws the pole and gains Pike. VAULTING SPIRIT (9) will find this a little easier than her third on debut two weeks ago, beaten just over a length over 1200m here. Has a low draw so she should be in the finish again. ROCKING IN VEGAS (1) is a genuine type with five minor placings from seven starts this time in work. Continued the trend last start when third over 1200m at Pinjarra after he was always up in the leading division. Looks well placed so expect another big run. CACHACA (3) stepped out for his debut over 1000m at Ascot back on March 11 and finished fifth, beaten 2.75 lengths. Top-three chance with that run under his belt. UNIMANDO (2) improved with each run in the debut campaign and has a terrible gate here but looked good when third in a recent trial.
